Triangulation Relay: 10-Block Curriculum progression and gate validation. Paul designed a 10-block boxing curriculum where each block has a gate (pass condition) before advancing. Block 1-4 are Body-engine dominant. Block 5 is the Emotion gate (the 4→5 wall where most students stall). Blocks 6-10 layer Mind and Emotion engines. The gates are Paul's drafts based on 15 years coaching — never externally validated. Are these gates real developmental thresholds or arbitrary checkpoints? Is the 4→5 emotion wall a genuine phenomenon or coaching mythology? What would validation look like? What does sports science say about staged skill acquisition with emotional gates? What is the right gate — observable behavior, self-report, coach judgment, or measurement?

Triangulation Relay: A Cathedral for someone else — Paul-specific vs universal architecture separation. The Cathedral is built around one person's research, taste, and cognitive signature. It has 78 PM2 processes, 15+ agents with memory, a knowledge vault of 10,000+ nuggets, and autonomous loops. What is genuinely universal architecture vs what is Paul-specific configuration? Could someone else build their own Cathedral? What would they need to change? What wouldn't transfer? Is the Cathedral a product, a method, or a one-off?

Triangulation Relay: Agent autonomy boundaries and the trust taxonomy. The Cathedral has 78 PM2 processes, 15+ agents with memory, and autonomous loops (Elicitor, Organism, Standing Agency). Some agents propose actions, some execute automatically. The trust gradient goes from manual-only to full autonomy. But the boundaries were set ad-hoc — kill switches added after spend burns, not before. What is the right trust taxonomy for AI agents that share a filesystem and can spend money? What should NEVER be autonomous? What earns autonomy — time, accuracy, or something else? How do you prevent the Cathedral from doing something Paul would regret while he sleeps?

Triangulation Relay: Ancient Corpus extraction gaps — Pipeline proven, are we extracting the right things? The Ancient Corpus Pipeline has ingested 4 corpuses (Emerald Tablets, Corpus Hermeticum, Nag Hammadi, Gilgamesh) using 5 methods (Convergence Detector, Teacher Voice, Live Thread, Three Tests, Antidote). But are these the right extraction methods? What are we missing? What would a textual scholar vs a practitioner vs an engineer extract differently from the same source material? Are we over-indexing on convergence and under-indexing on contradiction or practical application?

Triangulation Relay: Cosmology evidence grade — Independent outside grading of the same evidence. The Cathedral has 15 cosmology research tracks and a 17-layer audit across models including enclosed plane, electric universe, plasma cosmology, and sacred geometry. Current internal grades: Enclosed Plane A- vs Globe C+. But these grades were generated internally. What would an independent, adversarial but fair grading look like? Where is the Cathedral's cosmology research strongest and weakest? What claims would survive peer review and which would not?

Triangulation Relay: Is the Forgotten Shelf a real moat? The Archaeologist has mined 5,000+ abandoned/forgotten techniques across 14 domains (boxing, sports science, Soviet training, oral traditions, lost manuscripts, pre-digital science). These are real techniques with real citations — but only ~3/9 verified externally so far. Is this a defensible competitive advantage? Can someone else just run the same prompt and get the same results? What makes a knowledge mine a moat vs a pile? What is the Forgotten Shelf actually worth — and to whom?

Triangulation Relay: Paul's coaching IP product form — Preserve the Trojan Horse while scaling. Paul's coaching IP (Diagnostic Empathy with Surgical Naming, Fear Gate Model, Three Engines, 10-Block Curriculum) works BECAUSE people came for boxing. Marketing it directly kills it (Trojan Horse Principle). The skill has Grade A vault documentation. How do you productize a method that only works when disguised? What is the right product form — book, course, certification, software, or something else? What would each sacrifice?

Triangulation Relay: The Closed-Loop Coach spine: Gym Eyes (analyze) + Virtual Tutor (diagnose/compare) + Drill Player (demonstrate). All three built, none wired together. What does the wired loop actually look like? What is the student experience end-to-end? What breaks when you close the loop? What is the minimum viable wire — the thinnest connection that makes the three pieces feel like one system?

Triangulation Relay: The Master Game unified model. Paul's thesis: his interests (truth/wealth/business/AI/tools/healing/consciousness; boxing=one instrument) are facets of ONE game — the meta-game where leverage and meaning compound and feed each other. The Cathedral is a master-game machine; every module is an instrument. Is this a real unified theory or a post-hoc narrative that makes fragmentation feel intentional? What is the actual mechanism by which leverage and meaning compound? Can you name the feedback loops? What breaks the compound — what makes it decompound?

Triangulation Relay: What is Basic Reflex actually selling? ~15 products built (Gym Eyes, 10-block curriculum, Forgotten Shelf techniques, Three Engines, closed-loop coach, virtual tutor, kids programme, Cuba library, drill player, student homework, technique library, content studio, course engine, punchpass analytics). No unified revenue model. What is the actual product? What is free (proof), what is paid (value), what is the moat?
